en.purpose: To estimate free water deficit using serum sodium concentration, body weight, and estimated total body water.
en.use:
Use to estimate free water deficit in patients with dehydration.

Formula: Free water deficit [L] = K × weight [kg] × ((S-Na+ [mmol/L] / 140) - 1)

Where:
- S-Na+ = serum sodium concentration
- K = estimated total body water fraction

K values:
- Child: 0.6
- Adult male: 0.6
- Adult female: 0.5
- Older male: 0.5
- Older female: 0.45

The calculated result estimates the amount of free water deficit in liters.
en.misuse: Not to be used as the sole basis for fluid management or electrolyte correction. Clinical assessment and monitoring are required.

other_details.references: Morley JE. Dehydration, Hypernatremia, and Hyponatremia. Clin Geriatr Med. 2015 Aug;31(3):389-99. doi: 10.1016/j.cger.2015.04.007. Epub 2015 May 11. PMID: 26195098.
